novelty_flags.label: tldr, related_work, and def:cgd-assignment
novelty_flags.one_line: The core calls its target the published fixed CGD estimator without changing its algebra, but it replaces the paper's direct-effect conflict-graph eigenvalue by lambda_max(I+A_G), thereby changing Algorithm 1's exposure probabilities and Horvitz--Thompson weights.

soundness_flags.label: def:doob-decomposition and symbol \mathcal F_{n,j}
soundness_flags.one_line: j is a unit label while the filtration is written as sigma(U_{n,1},...,U_{n,j}) but described as revealing in Perron order; without an explicit rank-to-unit map, the claimed forward Doob increments are ambiguous and need not be the stated ones.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3.3, Algorithm 1, lines 299--303; Section D.9, lines 1522--1523; Section 5, Theorem 5.6, Corollary 5.7, and Propositions 5.3--5.4.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Algorithm 1 samples each desired exposure with probability 1/(4 lambda(H)) at r=2; for the paper's direct-effect star construction the conflict graph is G itself and lambda(H)=sqrt(n-1). The paper gives an o(n^(1/9)) CLT, ratio consistency, and Wald coverage in that published parameterization.
Theorem 2.3 treats finite L-delta moments for delta in [3,infinity), including delta=4; the paper is a generic dependency-graph result and does not analyze CGD.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association, published online 13 May 2026
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article characterizes conservative quadratic variance bounds under interference and complex designs, rather than a CGD-specific uniform normality or studentization frontier.
The preprint studies design-based minimax point-estimation risk over network experiments using conflict-graph connectivity; it is not a fixed-CGD Kolmogorov or Wald-coverage theorem.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Either restore the published direct-effect conflict matrix and its lambda(H) in the CGD algorithm, including the edgeless special case, or explicitly recast the work as a modified conservative CGD design and withdraw the claimed strict tightening of the published estimator.
Index the reveal filtration by rank r, define u_{n,r}=pi_n^{-1}(r), and rewrite every Doob increment and parent/child sum using u_{n,r}; then re-audit the stated decomposition.

After the parameterization repair, provide a worked non-star graph family where the o(n^(2/3)) frontier materially improves the published o(n^(1/9)) rule, alongside the repeated-star necessity construction.
